title: Proposed Illinois BUILD: current coverage plus screened middle-housing additions

screening.definition: Preserve the exact current map footprint; add conventional, non-unitized RS tax parcels above 2,500 sqft where the proposed unit allowance exceeds the current modeled zoning unit limit and no relevant parcel-area review blocker is known.
screening.rs_zero_comparator: Where the current RS zoning-unit formula yields zero on an undersized lot, compare to the one-detached-dwelling district ceiling instead; retain the original source cap and label the comparator basis. This does not establish the validity of an existing legal lot or dwelling.
screening.allowance_difference: Proposed unit allowance minus modeled district comparator, floored at zero. Not the number of new units over existing dwellings, a construction forecast or units attributable to stair reform.
screening.conditional_numeric_fields: Allowance and increment on review rows are conditional calculations and must not be summed as confirmed expansion.
limitations: Tax parcels are not verified legal zoning lots. Screening does not establish buildability, lot assembly, existing-building conversion feasibility or development likelihood.
A four-, six- or eight-unit middle-housing permission is not proof that a shared single stair is necessary or beneficial, nor does it grant six-story zoning.
Chicago detached-house restrictions in preservation areas and near rail entrances or designated bus corridors are not completely represented; RT/RM/B2 additions require review.
Special-use detached-house permissions are not automatically treated as by-right BUILD eligibility; unknown zoning classes remain unknown.
Small lots eligible only for one detached dwelling are not newly added to the middle-housing map.
SB4060 default bulk standards depend on municipal noncompliance after the transition and are not applied globally. Introduced-text cross-reference inconsistencies require legal review.
Existing-building conversion, ADUs, parking, permitting and impact-fee measures are not simulated by the parcel unit-allowance screen.
